verdict.rationale: Porkbun supplies the building blocks for unattended automation: portfolio-wide auto-renewal, signed real-time webhooks for registrations, renewals, transfers, expirations and DNS changes, and caller-IP detection for dynamic DNS. It also offers automation-safe API keys that work with 2FA and can be scoped by IP or domain, plus idempotent retries. Beyond auto-renew, though, the background automations themselves must be built and run by the user with external code or agents, since there is no native scheduler, rules engine or workflow builder. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduled or triggered automation engine, documented background agent workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
